spots.text: A note on the table: The lake is not deep. It is exactly as deep as the room above it. I have measured.

secrets.name: Under the Causeway
secrets.text: The door in the reflection is real. Under the causeway, below the level of the glass, a long dry room with a cot, a lamp, and a window of black mirror looking up at nothing.

meta.label: The Mirror Lake
meta.blurb: The floor is a black mirror a man's height down, and the whole hall stands on its own reflection. The causeways are the only thing holding you up. They are enough. Probably.
